about: Dry guitar recordings (DI, no amp) the player puts through the amp, listed in the input picker in this order, with 'Your guitar (audio input)' after them. To add one: encode it from its WAV as mono Opus (ffmpeg -i x.wav -c:a libopus -b:a 192k -vbr on -compression_level 10 -application audio x.opus), make a WebM copy of the same stream for Safari (ffmpeg -i x.opus -c:a copy x.webm), put both here and add an entry. file and fallbacks are relative to this list. seconds: its length (the player checks the decode against it). trim_db: gain before the amp (0 = the level it was recorded at). involts: the interface's calibration when it was recorded, volts at the guitar jack for 0 dBFS (omit for the amp's default).
